沒想到她竟然以大地的魔力為食不斷維持生命力，導致這塊大地逐漸貧瘠。甚至有人為了使: I never imagined she'd been feeding on the land's magic to stay alive, slowly making the land barren. Some people even want to help replenish her magic to bring her back, and made up the absurd hoax of the Day of Purification, all to restart the project!

必須盡快前往/c$#腐域深淵/c*，從/c$#覆面王者摩格納身上取得詠時魔晶/c: Hurry to /c$#Rotwood Abyss/c* and /c$#take the Chronochant Crystal from Masked King Magna/c*, or the consequences will be unthinkable.
你真的攔下了/c$#覆面王者摩格納/c*成功取回詠/c$#詠時魔晶/c*！幸好動: You really stopped /c$#Masked King Magna/c* and recovered the /c$#Chronochant Crystal/c*! 老了，腰酸背痛。: Getting old. My back aches all over.
嗯…嗯…這個我還是第一次遇到…: Hmm... hmm... this is a first for me...

請問你是冒險者嗎？: Excuse me, are you an adventurer?

她以前真的很溫柔，會照顧花，也會靜靜聽我們說話，只是後來變了，變得陌生又可怕，雖: She used to be really gentle. She cared for the flowers and listened quietly when we talked. But later she changed, became a stranger, and frightening. 詢問『腐域森淵』的路線結構: Ask about the layout of "Rotwood Abyss"
詢問『腐域森淵』的強敵特性: Ask about the bosses of "Rotwood Abyss"
『腐域森淵』是一個環形關卡，從最外圍的「/c$#蘑菇迷環/c*」開始，你們得一圈: "Rotwood Abyss" is a ring-shaped dungeon. Starting from the outermost "/c$#Mushroom Maze Ring/c*", you push toward the center one ring at a time, then cross the "/c$#Boomshroom Patrol Zone/c*" and the "/c$#Sub-Core Chamber/c*", and only then can you step into the true core: the "/c$#Heart of Corruption/c*", where Susula waits.
通過這道拱門，你會踏入一片色彩斑斕菌林，蘑菇在地上閃著柔和微光，看似夢幻，實則危: Through this arch you'll enter a colorful fungus forest, with mushrooms glowing softly on the ground. It looks dreamy, but danger lurks everywhere. This is the "/c$#Mushroom Maze Ring/c*", the first trial of the ruins.
你的任務是收集#顆「/c$#指引蘑菇/c*」，交給守在裡面的遺跡守護者，別看他一: Your task is to collect # "/c$#Guiding Mushrooms/c*" and give them to the Ruins Guardian inside. Don't mind his stern face, he just doesn't want more people to die for nothing. Prove you're strong enough, and he'll send your party deeper into the "/c$#Boomshroom Patrol Zone/c*". Once you go there, there's no turning back.
不過這些「/c$#指引蘑菇/c*」可沒這麼簡單，他們有一定的機率把你拖進陷阱房或: But these "/c$#Guiding Mushrooms/c*" aren't that simple. If you want to save yourself the trouble, you can challenge the first boss /c$#F-#/c* directly. Defeat it and your party gets # "/c$#Guiding Mushrooms/c*", skipping this gathering hell.
進入「/c$#爆菇巡邏區/c*」後，你會發現整個區域籠罩在紫色的毒霧中，光是呼吸: In the "/c$#Boomshroom Patrol Zone/c*" you'll find the whole area shrouded in purple poison mist. Just breathing costs HP, so watch your positioning to avoid the mist. Because of this magic-laden fog, the only way out is at the very end of the passage.
守護著這裡的/c$#米陶諾斯/c*是個牛頭戰士，牠高大魁武且不吃任何攻擊，就連超: The guardian here, /c$#Mitaunos/c*, is a bull-headed warrior. He's huge and immune to every attack. Even super-powerful magic can't hurt him!
牠唯一的破綻，是「/c$#爆菇巡邏區/c*」會定時長出一些「/c$#爆爆菇/c*: His only weakness: "/c$#Boom Mushrooms/c*" sprout in the "/c$#Boomshroom Patrol Zone/c*" at regular intervals. 接下來，你會進入「/c$#副核心室/c*」，這裡是蘇蘇拉設下的最後一道防線，那裡: Next you'll enter the "/c$#Sub-Core Chamber/c*", Susula's last line of defense. 當你們進入了「/c$#腐化之心/c*」，而長期被封印在這裡的/c$#蘇蘇拉/c*: When you enter the "/c$#Heart of Corruption/c*", you'll face /c$#Susula/c*, sealed here for ages. She wields powerful nature magic, controls flower buds and stirs up hurricanes. If you're not ready, don't go in lightly. This battle will be a true trial.
/c$#F-#/c*是個老古董機械守衛，但千萬別因為牠年久失修就小看它，它會定時: /c$#F-#/c* is an antique mechanical guard, but don't underestimate it just because it's run-down. 它的身體還會進入/c$#能量反彈/c*模式，紅光的時候物防爆表、藍光則是魔防超高: Its body also enters /c$#Energy Reflection/c* mode: when it glows red its physical defense skyrockets, when it glows blue its magic defense does. /c$#米陶諾斯/c*完全免疫所有攻擊，物理也打不動，魔法也沒用，唯一的破綻是場: /c$#Mitaunos/c* is completely immune to all attacks, physical or magical. /c$#蘇蘇拉/c*的戰鬥方式很刁鑽，不是直接打爆你，而是用一堆技能慢慢把你折磨: /c$#Susula/c* fights cunningly. Instead of blowing you away outright, she uses a pile of skills to slowly wear you down until you break.
